101-5612-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-5612-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Kudo, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3000-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3000-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1385-4279-6112--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1385-4279-6112--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat, Fumulus and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Fumulus ability, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4316-4478-5078-8171.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Vraska triggers, creating a 1/1 Sculpture Treasure artifact creature token.
Activate the token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

206-339-677-4247.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4247-5961--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Uncivil Unrest.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

1349-5147-5239.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one other nontoken creature.
Enduring Bondwarden has at least one coin counter on it.
1349-5147-5239.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Enduring Bondwarden.
When Enduring Bondwarden dies, it and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Bondwarden trigger, putting all counters from it onto another nontoken creature you control.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Enduring Bondwarden from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Enduring Bondwarden enters the battlefield, its backup ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature who had a coin counter placed on it, and giving it the printed ability until end of turn.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature with a coin counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, its ability from Enduring Bondwarden and Athreos' third ability trigger.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting all counters from it onto Enduring Bondwarden.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3478-6797-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

2079-2446-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2446-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Living Hive, triggering Breath of Fury and Living Hive.
Resolve the Living Hive trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

864-1312-2034-4871-5434.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

2034-4772-5086-5183-6996.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-4772-5086-5183-6996.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1445-1913-4871-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and an artifact creature card in your graveyard.
1445-1913-4871-6797.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Imotekh the Stormlord triggers if the creature that was returned to your hand was an artifact, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

789-2511-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
789-2511-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Gutter Grime and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gutter Grime trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.
789-2511-7084.notes: As Gutter Grime will get more and more slime counters, the final token you make will be infinitely large.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1322-2872-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Clever Conjurer.
Activate one of the Clever Conjurer tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Clever Conjurer token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

5795-6797-6871-6879.description:
Cast Barkform Harvester by paying {3}.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Barkform Harvester.
When Barkform Harvester dies, Haru triggers, returning Barkform Harvester from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Barkform Harvester enters, Haru triggers, targeting Barkform Harvester as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-4053-6797-6989.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1974-5299-5466.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Quicksilver Gargantuan
1974-5299-5466.description:
Cast Quicksilver Gargantuan by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Put Quicksilver Gargantuan into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Quicksilver Gargantuan's first ability and second ability trigger, along with Rakdos Joins Up's second ability.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's second trigger and Rakdos Joins Up's trigger, dealing damage to target opponent.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's first trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it as a copy of Rakdos Joins Up.
Repeat from step 2.

2608-4499-4563.notablePrerequisites: Everflowing Chalice has at least three charge counters on it.
2608-4499-4563.description:
Activate Everflowing Chalice by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Derevi.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Everflowing Chalice.
Repeat.

77-2511-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Faith Healer by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Elbrus, the Binding Blade // Withengar Unbound

386-1495-4613-5506.easyPrerequisites: Glistening Oil attached to Withengar Unbound.
386-1495-4613-5506.notablePrerequisites:
Withengar Unbound does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Withengar Unbound, or cannot prevent at least ten trample damage from Withengar Unbound.
Triskelion exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
386-1495-4613-5506.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Withengar Unbound, causing them to get at least ten poison counters.
The opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Withengar Unbound triggers, putting thirteen +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Withengar Unbound using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, giving an opponent a poison counter.
Repeat step 4 until the opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

802-1980-2459-2493-5326.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{B}.
You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
802-1980-2459-2493-5326.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Cast The Master either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {U}{B} and commander tax, if applicable, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Archaeomancer.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Snap to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Snap by paying {1}{U}, targeting The Master.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Snap, targeting Ornithopter.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{B}.
Resolve the copy of Snap, returning The Master to your hand from the battlefield, and untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1636-3143-4802.notablePrerequisites:
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nonlegendary creature token.
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1636-3143-4802.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of a creature token you control that enters the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

573-751-2653-3314.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Chulane triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Gruul Turf from your hand onto the battlefield.
Gruul Turf enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Nissa.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {U}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

863-1981-4378.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You have a way to cause the additional creature to die.
Vampirism attached to any creature you control, except the aforementioned additional creature.
863-1981-4378.description:
Cause the additional creature to die.
Sanguinary Priest triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain one life.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
The Soldier enters the battlefield as a 0/0 due to Vampirism and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3423.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least 8 artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3423.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{W}{R}.
Activate Aegis Automaton by paying {4}{W}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
